caption: The drawing depicts an ornate flat iron trivet with decorative features. The main object in the foreground is triangular in shape with rounded corners, resting on three short legs. The surface of the trivet is pierced with an intricate openwork design composed of interlacing geometric and curvilinear patterns, including a prominent central star shape. Attached to one side of the trivet is a sculpted figure of a reclining cherub or child, positioned with bent legs and arms tucked close to the body, and detailed facial features and hair. In the upper left corner of the drawing is a smaller, detailed side and top view of the same object, accompanied by a scale in inches for measurement. The artwork is rendered in monochrome, using shades of gray and black, providing shading and definition to highlight the textures and contours of the trivet and the figure. The drawing is contained within a rectangular border on a plain background, and the name "H. BADER" appears at the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Flat-iron Holder
